description: Prepare the end of an LV, MV or HV power cable for its termination or joint. The answer (thecablecode.prep/v1): steps[], each cut with the design's own depth and the diameter left; the makers' cut-back lengths for this voltage and size (makers' published instructions, unnamed, seen typical; none for low voltage); lug (the lug family by conductor class and metal, its standards, the strip length rule); for MV, accessories (free, also in the verdict: the termination and joint kinds two or more makers' kits fit, with the range their kit sizes cover at the Um, as GET /api/v1/accessories gives it), kits (each kind's range for this cable, length, sheds and creepage where two or more makers' public catalogues agree, no maker named; a kind one maker alone makes says so: why oneMaker) and creepage (the outdoor termination's minimum creepage per pollution class a to e, IEC TS 60815-3, with corrections and sources); fittings (gland diameters and IEC 62444 anchorage, EN 50181 connector interfaces, the IEC 61914 cleat force and the standing sheath voltage of single cores); and the step sheet PDF with pdf: true. Send the cable as design_cable takes it (sentence, spec or design) and the site in input. Use design_cable for the cable itself and commissioning_sheet for the tests after installation; this tool is only the end preparation. Without full and without payment the answer is the verdict a visitor sees on the site, counted against the designs' daily free allowance; full: true (or any paid call) answers in full. A separate paid call at its own price; a bad request costs nothing. input: {pollution?: a | b | c | d | e (the site pollution severity class of IEC TS 60815-1:2025 for the outdoor termination's minimum creepage; absent: every class, none picked; f, extremely heavy, has no reference value and is refused), edge?: true (the class read at its upper edge on the IEC TS 60815-1 curve), htm_lower?: true (an HTM insulator: one class lower), fittings?: {formation: trefoil | flat, spacingMm, currentA, lengthM (single-point bonded section), limitV, ikKa, rx, ipKa, leadM, cleatM, freq: 50 | 60, connectorA} (every field optional)} (the design decides the rest, and the kit's own instruction wins over the makers' lengths). $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; the free verdict counts against the designs' 2 free calls per caller per UTC day; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.
